13 | ## Required adoption behavior
14 | 
15 | Read the pinned skill and the relevant schema/example before coding. Preserve the typed JSON IR -> validation -> deterministic HTML/SVG delivery pipeline, five diagram types, stable identities, relationship direction, standalone viewer, static default, explicit finite motion, theme/preset semantics and canonical export rules. Keep the source graph separate from a bounded view projection. Retain notices and attribute Archify. Do not claim its existing viewer behaviors as Grepo inventions.
16 | 
17 | Use the exact CLI interface from the pinned skill. Showcase acceptance requires all nine artifact checks, zero composition errors and zero warnings. Nonzero delivery is failure; a prior artifact must not be relabeled as a new success. Treat deterministic validation, browser checks and perceptual review separately.
18 | 
19 | Grepo adds snapshot-grounded source analysis, capability records, evidence validation, Change Trails, counter-evidence, proposal/README synthesis, a React synchronization bridge, citrus styling and a Bob Change Pack. A postMessage/React bridge is a proposed Grepo integration, not an already verified upstream API.
20 | 
21 | ## Package boundary
22 | 
23 | This PRD bundle includes an adoption specification and the source/license links. It does not include the complete Archify runtime or claim that it is installed, executed or vendored. Source-file copying into the container was not used as evidence of execution. Vendor the complete approved package at the pinned revision during implementation and preserve its license and third-party notices. Do not copy only SKILL.md and assume the renderer files exist.
24 | 
25 | Suggested reviewed setup, run by the implementation team only:
26 | 
27 | ```sh
28 | git clone https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify vendor/archify
29 | git -C vendor/archify checkout --detach 9e35d2b0b39b155553ba9fcfe0b4f2a5198dd993
30 | # Read the pinned source and package instructions before executing its tools.
31 | ```
32 | 
33 | Do not auto-update the vendored package during a live user analysis.
